items.name: Sequence: writing submit, AI và retry
items.description: Sequence cho writing khi JobsService có sẵn. Session checkpoint tăng lúc enqueue; worker evaluation đến sau. Failed retry và terminal result không đồng nhất với session status.
items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Learner
    participant Sessions
    participant DB
    participant Jobs
    participant Handler
    participant Evaluation
    participant Provider
    participant Mastery
    Learner->>Sessions: submit writing with clientAttemptId
    Sessions->>DB: find owned session and attempt UUID
    alt same target UUID exists
        DB-->>Sessions: stored attempt
        Sessions-->>Learner: replay
    else new attempt at current checkpoint
        Sessions->>DB: transaction create raw response and QUEUED
        Sessions->>Jobs: enqueue EVALUATE_ATTEMPT in transaction
        Sessions->>DB: delete draft and CAS checkpoint
        Sessions-->>Learner: queued attempt
        Note over DB,Handler: Session may already be COMPLETED
        Handler->>DB: PROCESSING unless EVALUATED
        Handler->>Evaluation: evaluateAttempt
        Evaluation->>DB: lookup rubric result and input hash
        alt existing matching result
            DB-->>Evaluation: replay result
        else no result
            Evaluation->>Provider: evaluate with provenance
            alt success
                Evaluation->>DB: transaction result and EVALUATED
                opt mission purpose LEARNING
                    Evaluation->>Mastery: record scored evidence in transaction
                    Evaluation->>DB: project curriculum completion
                end
            else provider failure
                Handler->>DB: QUEUED if retry policy permits
                Note over Handler,DB: Otherwise EVALUATION_FAILED unless already EVALUATED
            end
        end
    end
    opt learner retries failed evaluation
        Learner->>Evaluation: retryForLearner
        Evaluation->>DB: check failed job and source availability
        Evaluation->>Jobs: retry owned retryable job
        Evaluation->>DB: failed attempt to QUEUED conditionally
    end

items.code:
sequenceDiagram
    actor Learner
    participant MockService
    participant DB
    actor Reviewer

    Learner->>MockService: start mock with UUID and mode
    MockService->>DB: pin version, LISTENING, deadline plus 30 min

    Learner->>MockService: get report
